title: 周日

series.next: Season one is over. 林老师 is taking bookings.

setting: Your parents' real living room, Sunday, 7 pm. 林老师 is in the kitchen doorway, with a notepad.

lin.name: 林老师
lin.en: in the kitchen, taking notes; has never smiled

steps.zh: 第十二次彩排。这次，是真的。
steps.en: Rehearsal twelve. This time, it's real.

else.zh: 你爸也知道了。……差不多知道。
else.en: Your dad knows too. ...More or less.

steps.narr: The real living room. The real dinner. 林老师 in the kitchen doorway, pen ready.

steps.en: You're home! You've lost weight! Eat!

steps.narr: Word for word what 老黄 said.

say.en: Tell them: you've quit your job. Third time; you know this one.
say.gloss: Mum, Dad, I've quit my job.
say.tip: 辞职 cízhí: episodes 2 and 5 were the rehearsals. This is the real one.

ok.narr: Exactly what 老黄 said, in exactly that voice.

answers: 爸妈，跟你们说件事，我辞职了。
3.gloss: Mum, Dad, there's something I need to tell you: I've quit.

say.en: Explain: you want to open your own shop.
say.gloss: I want to open my own shop.
say.tip: 自己开店 = open your own shop.

fail.en: Then what are you going to do?

1.gloss: I want to open a shop.

answers: 我想自己开店，计划都做好了。
我想自己开个店，计划都做好了。
3.gloss: I want to open my own shop. The plan's all worked out.

say.gloss: We'll talk about it when the time comes.
say.tip: 到时候再说: the third time you've said it this season.

answers: 妈，这事不急，到时候再说吧。
3.gloss: Mum, there's no hurry. We'll see when the time comes.

steps.narr: Every line, exactly as rehearsed. Too exactly.
Your mum takes a folded script out of her pocket. Your dad has one too.
Your mum puts the script down on the table.

say.en: Answer her: you're happy, or you don't know yet but you want to try.

alts.en: Or: not yet, but you want to try
answers: 还不知道，但是我想试试。
我还不知道，可是我想试试。
alts.gloss: I don't know yet. But I want to try.

answers: 妈，开心。这是我自己选的。
3.gloss: Mum, I'm happy. I chose this myself.

answers: 还不知道，但是我真的想试试。
alts.gloss: I don't know yet. But I really want to try.

steps.narr: 林老师 comes out of the kitchen and lays an envelope by every plate.

steps.en: Your dad gives you the biggest piece of fish, and says nothing at all. Season one ends here. 🧾

else.en: Your mum writes a cheque for the shop on the back of 林老师's invoice. Season one ends here. 🧾
